routeCandidates.name: Route A — NH-15 / NH-13 via Bomdila
routeCandidates.explanationText: The direct corridor is clear. Road condition is fair through the foothills and no rainfall is recorded on the alpine segments.

routeCandidates.name: Route B — Tezpur bypass via Kalaktang
routeCandidates.explanationText: A longer western approach with gentler gradients. Slower at rest, but it avoids the two highest-slope segments entirely.

routeCandidates.name: Route C — Eastern approach via Seppa
routeCandidates.explanationText: The longest option, on state roads for much of its length. Usable, but slower and rougher than either western route.

incidents.description: Slope failure on the Dirang approach; single lane passable with escort.
Rockfall debris across the carriageway below Sela Pass.
Standing water at the Orang culvert after overnight rain.
Surface breaking up on the Balipara stretch.
Culvert washout north of Bomdila; road closed to heavy vehicles.
Minor slip on the Tenga Valley bend; cleared to one lane.

routeCandidates.name: Route A — NH-15 / NH-13 via Bomdila
routeCandidates.explanationText: Heavy rainfall, poor road condition and historical landslide zones are the main contributors to the elevated risk for Route A.

routeCandidates.name: Route B — Tezpur bypass via Kalaktang
routeCandidates.explanationText: Rainfall on this corridor is lighter and it avoids the landslide-prone Bhalukpong–Tenga stretch, so both risk and travel time hold steady.

routeCandidates.name: Route C — Eastern approach via Seppa
routeCandidates.explanationText: Moderate rainfall and poor surface condition raise this route materially, though it stays below the disruption threshold.

recommendation.recommendationText: Pre-position 100 units of medicine to Tawang from Bomdila Highland Depot. Transfer covers the projected 32-hour shortfall with 9 hours of margin.

alerts.title: Tawang medicine stock projected to run out
alerts.message: Delay on NE-102 pushes projected stockout to 32 hours, below the 48-hour safety line. Pre-positioning recommended.

alerts.message: Heavy rainfall in the Tawang region lifted Bhalukpong–Tenga Valley from 43 to 87. Reroute to Route B recommended.
